name: Stark
description:
Make Stark a native part of your AI workflow. Use it to create projects, scan assets, and quickly remediate accessibility issues across your entire workflow including design, code, and production.

Key features:
- Track your team's accessibility progress across all of your projects so you can determine what progress you're making.
- Easily add new assets (Figma, code, automated test scans, URL, etc.) within projects to set them up for automatic monitoring.
- Pull down asset scan results with full issue context to make quick and confident fixes
- View your compliance journey and see which framework controls need attention

Pair with our SKILLs or plugin for a complete accessibility AI workflow.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Stark to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Stark to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.getstark.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Stark MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Stark lists 13 MCP tools, including create-android-asset, create-automated-test-asset, create-code-asset, create-figma-asset, create-ios-asset, create-storybook-asset, create-url-asset, get-asset-violations, get-compliance-center-summary, get-project-summary, get-team-summary, and list-projects.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Stark?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Stark in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Stark requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Stark is developed by Stark Lab, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
